content: Detlot pipul hu nomo laigim miksap garram najalot pipul oldei jinggabat olabat ronselp, en dei nomo agri langa ola rait ting weya ebribodi sabi.
Detlot hu nomo sabi nomo wandim len en sabi mowa blanga dum gudwan ting. Dei oldei reken dei jidan sabibala langa olabat main.
Wen pipul dumbat brabli nogudwan ting dei garra fil sheim, dumaji det dubala ting wek mijamet, en wen pipul stap rispek langa yu, yu garra abumbat trabul.
Det gudwan wed brom sambodi gin album pipul jis laik det freshwan springwoda weya gibit laif langa ebrijing.
Im nomo gudwan blanga larramgo giltiwan fri, en im nogud wen yu nomo gibit feyago langa detlot gudbala pipul.
Wen sambodi hu nomo jinggabat gudwei stadimap agamin, im jis laik im askimbat enibodi blanga beldimap im.
Wen det sambodi hu nomo sabi tok, wal im ronwan wed trepam im en gibit im trabul.
Wen enibodi deigimbat yan, pipul oldei laigim kipgon dalimbat det yan.
Leisiwan pipul jidan jis laik sambodi hu bitsimap ebrijing.
Wal YAWEI det trubala God im brabli strongbala jis laik det strongbala haus weya detlot pipul hu oldei dumbat ola gudbala ting gin go blanga jidan seifwan.
Bat ola ritjwan pipul oldei trastimbat olabat ebrijing blanga kipum olabat seifwan, en olabat reken detlot ebrijing jidan jis laik haiwan wol langa bigwan taun.
Pipul garra shoum rispek langa detlot pipul hu nomo jidan praudbalawei, bat detlot pipul hu oldei jidan praudbalawei garra abum bigiswan trabul.
Yu garra lisin bifo yu ensa. If yu nomo lisin, wal yu brabli siliwan.
Nomeda if yu sikwan det filing blanga yu garra meigim yu jidan gudwei, bat if yu gibap, wal yu garra dai.
Detlot pipul hu oldei jinggabat gudwei oldei wandim blanga len mowa.
Wen yu wandim midim speshalwan pipul, if yu deigim presen langa im, wal im meigim mowa isiwan blanga midim im.
Wen yu irrim det stori blanga det men langa kothaus yu reken det stori im truwan, bat wen sambodi askimbat im kwestjan, yu wanwanbat na.
Wen dubala men kipgon agamin gija langa kothaus, maitbi dei gin tjakambat det dubala speshalwan ston, blanga sodimat det trabul.
Wen yu album yu rileishan im garra kipum yu seif jis laik bigwan wol kipum det taun seifwan, bat if yu agamin langa im, wal im kaan album yu, najing.
Yu garra wotjim miselp hau yu tok. Wanim yu tok gin albumbat yu o gibit yu bigis trabul.
Wanim yu tok gin meigim pipul jidan laibala o dedbala. Wal blanga tharran na yu garra wotjim wanim wed yu tok.
Wen eni men faindim waif wal im faindim gudwan ting, en tharran shoum im YAWEI gudbinji langa im.
Wen ola po pipul askim ola ritjwan pipul blanga album olabat, dei garra tok gudwei, bat wen ola ritjwan pipul tokbek langa olabat, dei oldei tok rafwei langa olabat.
Sambala yu frenmob nomo trubala, bat yu ronwan fren gin album yu mowa den yu femili.
